game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Glowworm Gallery Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery, a ceiling of glowworms: the dwarf scout must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery: a ceiling of glowworms
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowworm Gallery, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round, cave spiders strike the wooden door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wooden door from cave spiders in Glowworm Gallery: keep the dungeon_clear meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: dungeon_clear drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Glowworm Gallery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while dungeon_clear > 0.
